mail/smtp_data#

The DATA content of an SMTP transaction: a message made ready to send.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let data = PreparedSmtpData(origin: message, capabilities: capabilities);
data.body_mode();                    // seven_bit or eight_bit_mime, for MAIL FROM BODY=
data.message_size();                 // for MAIL FROM SIZE=
data.bytes();                        // dot-stuffed, ending in ".\r\n"

Description#

The DATA content of an SMTP transaction: a message made ready to send.

The message is read once: Bcc and Resent-Bcc are removed, lines are checked for CRLF and length, 8-bit content needs the server's 8BITMIME, leading dots are doubled and the terminator added. Nothing is recoded to 7 bits and nothing is sent. By default a message may have 64 MiB and lines of 1000 bytes.
